relationship: Partly adapts Hyptosis 48px originals to LPC 32px with fewer colors; Frama extends this set.
source_facts_basis: Owner/source-page facts supplied in scoped intake assignment; source binary inspected locally.
limitations: No game selection, palette reduction, resampling, collision inference or semantic guarantees.
Empty slots retain native source size; tight output is a transparent 1x1 sentinel with null tight_bbox.
Grid reconstruction exactly covers every original PNG pixel, including edge partial cells.
RGBA decoding preserves source colors and alpha; indexed storage representation remains preserved in original/.
